Application Data.NAME: Cozy Comfort Linens
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Comfort Lane, Suite 100, Cozy Town, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Cozy Comfort Linens specializes in offering a wide range of bath and bedding products, including luxurious sheets, plush towels, and cozy blankets. Our retail shop focuses on providing high-quality, stylish home textiles to enhance the comfort and aesthetics of our customers' living spaces. We aim to create a welcoming shopping experience, with knowledgeable staff ready to assist customers in selecting the perfect items for their homes. We also offer seasonal promotions and customized bedding solutions to cater to diverse customer needs.
